newsitem.title: ISRAEL: ECI wins $30 million Belgacom order.
newsitem.headline: ECI wins $30 million Belgacom order.

text.p: ECI Telecom Ltd said on Wednesday it had an agreement with Belgium's Belgacom to be the sole supplier of Access Network pair gain multiplexer equipment.
It said sales from the three-year contract with Belgium's partially privatised telephone company could exceed $30 million.

Under the deal, ECI will deliver and deploy its Access products, including PCM2, PCM4, PCM11, and ASLMX systems. All utilise high bit rate digital subscriber loop (HDSL) technology to increase the number of transmissions over telephone lines.
The contract has an option to be extended to five years, ECI said.
ECI designs, develops, manufactures and markets digital telecommunications and data transmission systems.
